description:
FOUND s496a (Opus resume agent s499, 2026-09-27).  OWED BOOKKEEPING, not a product bug.

s496a spliced its companion movers into the FILE-level snapshot baselines/perl-suite-run.tsv (commits 0ab64a45 + the member-7 splice), but NOT into the two ROW-level companion baselines, baselines/perl-suite-fails.tsv (I1, the ROW DIFF) and baselines/row-shortfall.tsv (I2, SHORTFALL).  A run over the batch's mover files therefore prints (scratch/s496a/comp-m7final.log in worktree agent-a656873eaa3acc2ca, tree 1ae1f247):

  ROW DIFF: 606 NEW ROW, 420 FIXED ROW, 23 UNVERIFIED, 2 LOST
    NEW by file:   re/pat_rt_report.t 470, re/regexp_unicode_prop.t 93, re/pat.t 42, op/ref.t 1
    FIXED by file: re/regexp_unicode_prop.t 336, re/pat.t 43, re/pat_rt_report.t 26, uni/class.t 12, op/lc.t 3
  SHORTFALL NEW: re/pat.t 898 -> 962, re/pat_advanced.t 0 -> 842 (UNEXPLAINED), re/pat_rt_report.t 4 -> 2400, re/regex_sets.t 8 -> 96

Causes, per file (all measured in s496a, the snapshot rows carry them):
  re/regexp_unicode_prop.t, uni/class.t, op/lc.t  -- UP on #2060 (properties from perl's tables); regexp_unicode_prop.t's NEW rows are largely DESCRIPTION-PAIRING artifacts (1014 + 96 = 1110 = perl's count, yet 41 "(missing)" qr/\P{..}/ rows: the file repeats descriptions)
  re/pat.t          -- #2383 code-block condition (?(?{..})..) dies since #2372 (206/99)
  re/pat_advanced.t -- one top-level form aborts: line 1106 qr/(??{..})/ (not-supported Â§Regex code blocks) dies AT THE qr since member 7; before, line 1122's recursion (#2382)
  re/pat_rt_report.t -- line 401 qr/(\x{100}++)/ possessive (#2380) dies AT THE qr since member 7 (110/4); before, (*:B) at line 872 (#2386)
  re/regex_sets.t   -- every statement dies at its unsupported qr/(?[..])/ (registered XDIFF reason; rows re-blessed for this file in s496a)
  op/ref.t "UNIVERSAL::AUTOLOAD called when freeing qr//" -- NOT s496a: present on the b6560c21 base run too; owned by #2061 / #2342 / #2407.

DO: edit the two files ROW BY ROW with these causes (the s494g commit dc6c4793 is the pattern: a header note naming the batch, rows removed/added by edit), A/B against the pre-batch extraction; for regexp_unicode_prop.t first decide whether its duplicated descriptions should be keyed by occurrence (a tool question, cf. #1966's one key projection).  Why not done in s496a: member 7 (Fable ruling s499) was bounded at ~1 h and this is 1,000+ rows of bookkeeping over seven files.


=== DONE (s504, Fable, 2026-10-02) ===
ONE quiet FULL companion run on main b7ec0093 (~/pcl-agent-scratch/s504/companion/run.log + run.tsv; 528 files; ROW DIFF 492 NEW / 1878 FIXED / 16 LOST; 31 files off the snapshot).  Every non-regexp mover was ATTRIBUTED by running it on 22 `git archive` extractions of main`s merge points (s504/attrib/table.txt + r2/): s492c 8d41b6b6, s495f dc20a721, s496a 577a09a4, s497b bd0c38e3, s501b 2284d58d -- NOT only s496a as this task assumed.

- THE OPEN QUESTION (key regexp_unicode_prop.t by occurrence?) is ANSWERED NO: two runs of one tree gave 1014/96 both times and 246 vs 288 diverging rows -- hash-order pairing, the op/hash.t class.  Registered *rows-unstable*; re/pat.t likewise (the `20000 nodes` rows + the sliding 500-row window).
- baselines/row-shortfall.tsv: pat_advanced 842, reg_nocapture 14, reg_pmod 60, script_run 12 explained; pat.t / pat_rt_report / proto / pos / rxcode amended.
- baselines/perl-suite-expected-rows.tsv + expected.tsv: re/script_run.t re-blessed (104 ACCIDENTAL passes since #2372, reason amended).
- baselines/perl-suite-notrun-stamps.tsv: re-stamped s504 (the previous full run was s473t4, 2026-09-13).
VERIFY: a run over the 30 touched files reads 0 NEW ROW / 0 FIXED / 0 LOST, no snapshot difference, shortfall clean (s504/companion/verify.log).
DELIBERATELY NOT SPLICED (a regression is fixed, not blessed): the eight re/regexp.t wrappers (#2633, 7,752 rows) and mro/method_caching_utf8.t (#2634).  op/gmagic.t left to s501t.
